newsitem.title: USA: Kimco Realty may set up new REIT.
newsitem.headline: Kimco Realty may set up new REIT.

text.p: Kimco Realty Corp said Monday it may set up a new real estate investment trust for properties generating fixed market-rate rents under long-term leases.
Kimco said it may establish the entity this year by transferring some properties into the new trust and distributing a portion of the new entity to its existing shareholders as a dividend.
It added it is assuming the new trust would have an initial size of $150 million, with two-thirds debt financing and Kimco retaining a 40 percent stake.

Kimco said if it formed the new trust it expected a higher return on its retained investment as the new trust would be leveraged higher than its current structure, in addition to earning management fees.
Kimco's stock rose 1/4 Monday morning to 34-1/8.
